blocks.title: Multi-cloud
blocks.text: Multi-cloud kai mukhtalif providers ki cloud services istemal karta, ek provider par inhisar se bachata aur aitbaar aur kaarkardagi behtar karta hai.

Company data analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, karobari applications ke liye Microsoft Azure aur backup aur aafat se bahali ke liye Amazon Web Services istemal kar sakti hai, ta ke ek provider mein masla ho to baqi kaam karte rahein.

blocks.prompt: Multi-cloud hybrid cloud se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid public aur private ko milata hai; multi-cloud ek par inhisar se bachne ke liye kai providers ki clouds (aksar sab public) istemal karta hai.

items: Multi-cloud: mazbooti ke liye kai providers (GCP, Azure, AWS).
